name: The Trails of Frisco Golf Club
_comment_tees: Scorecard from GolfPass (22710); its pars match OpenStreetMap's hole tags. GolfPass names the rated tees Championship, Back, Middle and Forward; matched by total yards to Black, Blue, White and Red.
_comment_shift: OSM outlines sit this many metres off the Esri imagery (measured by fitting the greens to the overseeded greens in the winter imagery; the dormant fairways read as sand, so a bunker fit is off); every point is moved by it.
_comment_drop: Polygons containing these points are not part of the course (three practice greens, a second, bigger outline OSM draws round #16's green, out over the creek, and one bunker on plain grass).
